scope: Gate3 physical-law/contact component qualification; no tomato/robot adoption
backend: Independent total-Lagrangian MPM, fixed reference quadratic B-spline weights; explicit symplectic/MUSL, pure FLIP; no viscosity/plasticity

material.provenance: Provisional component material from prior block scale, NOT calibrated tomato, NOT identical to CRESSim corotational law

time.basis: Below 0.2*h/sqrt((lambda+2mu)/rho) for initial elastic diagnostic; refine and reject inadmissible volume

topology.method: persistent ternary cut-side codes, compatible antisymmetric nodal momentum exchange, fixed reference stencils
topology.assignment: finite edge swept during current action; geometry-only topology fixtures at Gate 2
topology.capacity_overflow: reject before mutation; never erase history

contact.gate2: No material/tool collision response in topology-only controls; separate no-contact, receding fragment probes. Physical resistance and recontact remain Gate 3

screens.angular_basis: 1% over 0.01 s dynamic free-spin screen plus static rotated stress objectivity and half-step comparison; discretization screen not exact conservation proof
screens.cut_bridge: partial incision retains connected unassigned bridge; no complete partition
screens.topology_refinement: same discrete cut verdict at dt/2

preservation: No changes to old CRESSim, Isaac, DiSECt, robot, kitchen, grip, trajectory, packages or environments
stop: Failed substantive gate after at most one diagnosed correction, or first-phase budget; no automatic second engine

numerical_correction.change: Use preplanned 3/1.5 mm candidate resolution and 12.5 us timestep; no constitutive/transfer algorithm changes
numerical_correction.reason: Coarse angular error persists under temporal refinement (1.23%), falls to 0.357% under spatial refinement; halve dt also needed for dynamic compression velocity agreement. Physical dimensions, density and thresholds unchanged.

cutting_candidate.law: Ideal rate-independent cutting work, energy Gc times newly created reference area; sharp-edge contact and positive material-relative advance required; transactional irreversible commit
cutting_candidate.provenance: Existing synthetic reference toughness, not tomato measurement; NEW law not the old bilinear cohesive model
cutting_candidate.budget: Area partition once per unique material patch; no per-band-particle multiplication or inherited whole-interface budget

contact_candidate.geometry: Exact existing watertight blade CAD; reconstructed trilinear material cells with contact force pullback
contact_candidate.whole_material_guard: Independent adaptive volume covering with 1-Lipschitz signed CAD distance; interval motion bound; uncertified states rejected
contact_candidate.provenance: Numerical penalty and provisional friction for component tests, not calibrated tomato

one_correction_policy: One diagnosed correction and bounded retest per substantive failed gate, then report/reassess; no parameter tuning to force pass
